title: Tridactyl beings of Peru from the Nazca period

tellings.quote: the tridactyl beings in Peru from dated from the Nazca period where there's cave art all over there. One of the the um biioinformatics genetics people found a mutation that matches a human mutation that involves digit differences on the finger.

plain: Three-fingered bodies found in Peru date from the Nazca period, the time of an ancient culture there that left cave art all over the area, and a genetics researcher found in them a mutation matching a human one that changes the fingers, Michels says. He tells this while talking with the musician Flying Lotus, pointing to the Mexican journalist Jaime Maussan, who has promoted the bodies. If true, it would suggest the beings were real and linked in some way to humans.
